cases.name: a guard is dropped from CI and stays in check.sh
caught_by: every check.sh step runs in a workflow or is in ONLY_LOCAL

cases.name: the client's typecheck is dropped from CI
cases.old:
- run: npx --no-install tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
        working-directory: clients/typescript
caught_by: every check.sh step runs in a workflow or is in ONLY_LOCAL

cases.name: the go client's gofmt wrapper is dropped from CI
cases.old:
- run: test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" || { echo "gofmt would rewrite:"; gofmt -l .; exit 1; }
        working-directory: clients/go
caught_by: every check.sh step runs in a workflow or is in ONLY_LOCAL
